checks: corpus_version and chunking_version recomputed from data/processed/chunks
BM25 vocabulary and document count reproduced from the live index
FeatureReranker.config() compared field-by-field with the artifact
parse_identifiers compared old-vs-new over all 111 golden queries

definitions.recall@k: hit-rate — at least ONE expected chunk in the top k
definitions.all_target_recall@k: every expected chunk in the top k
definitions.mrr: mean reciprocal rank of the FIRST expected chunk; a miss contributes 0
definitions.candidate_rank: position in the interleaved dense∪lexical pool, searched to pool end
definitions.reranked_rank: position after the feature reranker, searched to 10
definitions.relevance: binary; graded relevance is not supported by this corpus

candidate_retrieval.cross_check_note: the identity reranker restates the candidate order; its recall@1/5/10 must equal the figures above

reranking_effect.movement_convention: positive = the first correct chunk moved up

failure_analysis.attribution: every miss is a ranking miss; candidate generation lost nothing

non_operative_chunk_at_rank_1.description: a preamble, title page or chapter heading of the right instrument outranked the provision that answers the question

multi_chunk.project_semantics: ANY-target (hit-rate). Every earlier artifact uses it.
multi_chunk.all_target_note: computed over the stored top 10; deeper ALL-target recall is not recoverable from these artifacts

ground_truth_verification.note: Ground-truth verification status is not retrieval performance, and neither is legal accuracy. No answer in this project has been independently evaluated for legal correctness.
